product_one_liner.value: Qubrid provides developers, researchers, and enterprises a unified AI platform for building, deploying, managing, and scaling AI/ML workloads.
product_one_liner.notes: The documentation describes a unified environment for developers, researchers, and enterprises to build, deploy, manage, and scale AI/ML workloads.

pricing_page.notes: Qubrid has a public page titled Pricing that presents its pricing information.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage includes a customer testimonial attributed to Lern.Law, and Qubrid's case-study index names Chaitanya Bharathi Institute of Technology in a case study. | named_customers.0: The testimonial is attributed to Lern.Law's Chief Revenue Officer. | named_customers.1: The official case-study index names Chaitanya Bharathi Institute of Technology in a case study.

employee_band.notes: The cited records give an employee count of 16, which falls in the required 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Qubrid's contact page gives a McLean, Virginia address, and a company profile explicitly identifies McLean as its headquarters city. | hq_country: The company is identified as headquartered in the United States, and its contact page gives a McLean, Virginia headquarters address.

founded_year.notes: The company profile states the year founded as 2023, and the Tracxn record for qubrid.com also lists founded_year 2023.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows workflow guides, platform/product content, and enterprise-solution material, but the reviewed index did not show at least two posts by engineers explaining how Qubrid itself is built.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal exposes multiple sections, including a changelog, model comparison, API reference, getting started, introduction, and quickstart.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers listing includes an open Full Stack AI Engineer position, which meets the title-based AI-role criterion.

model_provider.value: Qubrid publicly supports 30+ open-source models, including LLaMA, Mistral, CodeLlama, and Stable Diffusion; its Dify Marketplace plugin also lists DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, and GLM.
model_provider.notes: Qubrid's FAQ names open-source models it supports, while the Dify Marketplace announcement lists additional models accessible through the Qubrid plugin. The sources describe a multi-model offering rather than one exclusive provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Qubrid's FAQ explicitly says it uses SOC 2 compliance; its hosting page separately uses the wording “SOC Type 2.” I report SOC 2 and do not infer other certifications. | compliance_certs.0: The FAQ names SOC 2 compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook lists the June 2024 Angel (individual) transaction as completed and marks the $25M Seed round as upcoming. A secondary listing reports a September 2026 Seed round without establishing that it closed, so the latest confirmed completed stage is Angel (individual). | funding_date: PitchBook dates the completed Angel transaction to June 14, 2024; the separate funding-round listing gives June 2024. The requested YYYY-MM value is therefore 2024-06. | funding_amount_usd: A funding-round listing gives $250K for the June 2024 Angel round; PitchBook identifies the June 2024 Angel transaction as completed. The amount is from a secondary funding listing, so this field carries some source uncertainty.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest confirmed completed round is dated June 2024, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025. The $25M Seed round in PitchBook is explicitly marked upcoming, not completed.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists GPU Kubernetes Cluster Engineer and Full Stack AI Engineer roles; neither is an SDR, BDR, or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: The July 17, 2026 announcement says the Qubrid AI plugin is now on the Dify Marketplace and enables multi-model access, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The About page is a founder note listing Pranay Prakash, not a complete leadership roster. The retrieved CEO profile shows a Qubrid AI start date of 2024-04-01, outside the 12-month window, but the available evidence cannot establish a full leadership roster or departures; the answer is unknown.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Qubrid AI job posting explicitly names HubSpot and Zoho in its CRM instruction. | crm_stack_signal.0: The Qubrid AI job post names HubSpot. | crm_stack_signal.1: The Qubrid AI job post names Zoho.
